name: Tiny
description: Imps, sprites, mice, and other diminutive creatures. Two Tiny creatures fit in a 5-foot square.

name: Small
description: Halflings, gnomes, and goblins. Small creatures occupy the same square as a Medium creature.

name: Medium
description: Most humanoids — humans, elves, dwarves, orcs. The default size for player characters.

name: Large
description: Giants, ogres, owlbears, and similar oversized creatures. Occupies a 2-by-2 grid of 5-foot squares.

name: Huge
description: Adult dragons, hill giants, and other towering monsters. Occupies a 3-by-3 grid.

name: Gargantuan
description: Ancient dragons, krakens, and titanic creatures. Occupies a 4-by-4 grid or larger.
